4363.title: Turn-start watchdog does not terminate a pending request
4363.rootCauseOneLine: The watchdog emits a warning without retiring the pending start or emitting a terminal event; the underlying Claude stall remains unverified.
4363.proposedFix: Trace the bridge stall and define cancellation plus late-start handling before making timeout terminal.
4363.caveats: Runtime-only reproduction; no live Claude or server queue reproduction.
